status: DRAFT for review (Sudan Map Designer, 2026-10-27); not wired into the build
purpose: Show where South Sudanese and borderland communities (Shilluk, Azande, Dinka, Nuer, Anuak; more as the Historian adds them) are attested, as an overlay inside the eras where they are present, instead of as timeline eras.
neutrality: One ink, one pattern and one symbol for every group: no per-group colour ranking, no size or weight by population or political status.
Labels are the group's self-name with the common exonym, e.g. 'Dinka (Jieng)'; alphabetical draw/legend order.
No 'kingdom/tribe' wording in the layer; polity history stays in era text written by the Historian.
Areas are anchor zones or text-derived limit points, never borders; no fill that reads as territory/control.

area.why: stipple is unused by other layers (hatch = APPROXIMATE/CONTESTED, solid = polity fill), so it reads as 'people present', not control

overlap.rule: where two groups share an area or point (shared_with not null), both are drawn; areas stipple-on-stipple with offset grids, points as a split ring (two half-rings, alphabetical left/right) labelled 'shared: A / B' (no CONTESTED badge unless a source states a dispute)
overlap.contested: only where a cited source states a dispute: add canonical CONTESTED badge and the project's contested hatch over the stipple; none in the current draft

label.ar: label_ar, RTL, same size; shows [يحتاج تحقق] chip until reviewed; null -> EN only

symbology.approximate: APPROXIMATE features keep the same stipple at 60% dot density plus the existing APPROXIMATE chip; no extra colour

result.3:1 and dE00 vs every era fill: FAIL for the ink alone (no colour in the 4.5/3:1 band clears all 37 era fills+strokes; best search result dE00 12.4 / CVD 7.4). Separation from fills relies on the halo/outline pair, as with the culture layers; needs the same IM era-fill waiver.

contrast_measured.method: WCAG 2 relative luminance; CIEDE2000; CVD via Machado 2009 (protan/deutan/tritan, severity 1.0); era fills = fill/stroke hex in db/legends/eras/*.json + legend_spec.json

data.era_rule: show a feature in an era when present_eras contains the era id, else when [present_start,present_end] overlaps the era span

needs_from_historian: ethnic-group records (one per group) with stable group id, EN name + self-name, AR name, and cited presence spans (start/end or era-id list) to replace the spans copied from the old community eras (Dinka/Nuer/Anuak 1500-2026 and Shilluk 1490-1861 are era spans, not attested presence)

for each group, cited place anchors (cities.json place_ids or Wikidata) for areas the layer should mark; the current draft has only 11 features and no Azande, Nuer or Anuak homeland points with geometry (homelands.geojson grp-azande-homeland / grp-nuer-homeland have null geometry)
a cited source for the Shilluk area: the only polygon is OHM_2856878 (CC0, no source tag), kept as VERIFY
any cited statement of shared/disputed areas (to set shared_with / CONTESTED)
Arabic review of all label_ar (all tagged [يحتاج تحقق])
whether further groups (e.g. Murle, Bari, Toposa, Fur/Masalit for the north) belong in the same layer
once periods.json drops the five community eras, the Map Designer removes their extents/legends/group layer and repoints geometry_from
